payload.title: FND-04: Normative provider-effect ownership

behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Providers leaf effect is canonical in standards and checker fixtures.
edges aggregates provider effects unchanged as the root/test override bag.
No competing provider catalog or execution abstraction is introduced.
Typecheck/lint and focused checker tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Standards and checker rule only; do not implement Providers service migration.
Do not race the live standardized-provider-neutral-conductor task on composition paths.
Do not change CLI manifest generation.

payload.title: FND-05: Hosted-source vs hosted-runner ownership rules
payload.requestedOutcome: Update hosted-source versus hosted-runner ownership rules so Automation polling and Workers hosted execution are distinguished mechanically. This unlocks later IMP-AUTO-05.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Automation polling and Workers hosted execution are distinguished by mechanical ownership rules/fixtures.
Normative standards no longer assign hosted polling to Workers where Automation owns it.
Typecheck/lint and focused checker tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Standards and checker rule only; do not move hosted_logic or automation packages yet.
Do not take Wire/root or provider-conductor leases.
Do not change public CLI/OpenAPI contracts.

payload.title: FND-06: Audit and narrow edges.Edges imports
payload.requestedOutcome: Audit and narrow edges.Edges imports without removing the edges exception. Root and functional-test overrides must remain compatible while implementation imports of the broad bag disappear from constructed services.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Constructed service implementation imports of broad edges.Edges disappear or are rejected by enforcement.
edges remains the documented architecture exception and is not deleted or generalized into a service locator.
Typecheck/lint and focused edges/import tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Lease is pkg/services/edges and direct import-narrowing only.
Do not redesign Wire/root beyond import narrowing required by this packet.
Do not migrate provider or CLI surfaces.
verification: focused edges import and override tests

payload.requestedOutcome: Add the Petri-public-surface prohibition so raw nets, markings, tokens, transitions, and engine snapshots fail outside Runtime internals. This unlocks later IMP-RUN-01.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Raw nets/markings/tokens fail checker fixtures outside Runtime internals.
Public API, transports, integration contracts, and functional-test fixtures are covered by the prohibition fixtures.
Typecheck/lint and focused Petri-boundary checker tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Architecture checker and fixtures only; do not perform Runtime orchestration migration here.
Do not change customer-facing CLI/OpenAPI contracts solely for package motion.
Do not take provider-conductor or CLI-manifest leases.

payload.requestedOutcome: Freeze canonical Factory Event ownership and schema inventory so producers and consumers compile against one Recordings-owned vocabulary. This unlocks later IMP-REC-01 and informs PSS-I05.

Event-contract ownership is explicit and stable-sorted for later deletion-only debt tracking.
Typecheck/lint and focused event-inventory/contract tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Event-contract inventory and ownership freeze only; do not migrate Recordings implementation packages yet.
Do not change public event payload shapes solely to ease package motion.
Do not take CLI-manifest or provider-conductor leases.
